items.lede: TeamPCP pulled off the worst-ever software supply-chain hacking spree and breached thousands of companies. Now Google’s threat intelligence group says it had a mole inside the hackers’ inner circle.
items.title: An Undercover Google Analyst Infiltrated a Notorious Supply-Chain Hacking Gang
